recipes.label: Rebuild from a supplied reference
recipes.summary: Reconstruct supplied HTML, screenshots or extracted pages while preserving declared source details and validating the rendered result.
useWhen: A supplied page, extraction or screenshot defines the requested visual and interaction target.
avoidWhen: The user asks for open-ended concept exploration without an existing target.

recipes.label: Repair precise visual feedback
recipes.summary: Apply itemized corrections to the current approved artifact and verify the requested delta together with protected properties.
useWhen: The user identifies incorrect geometry, typography, content, component states or unintended changes to approved work.
avoidWhen: There is no visual artifact or reference; use the actual domain diagnosis instead.

recipes.label: Roll out shared design changes
recipes.summary: Update canonical components, typography and theme presets across a declared target set, checking affected states and exported outputs.
useWhen: Changes to shared components, fonts, modes, accents or presets must propagate across pages or an editor catalogue.
avoidWhen: Only one self-contained image is being edited and no shared design system is involved.

recipes.label: Convert to native editable YAML
recipes.summary: Map supplied sources to the receiving kit and real widget capabilities, then validate editable structure, assets and import/render parity.
useWhen: The requested deliverable is a native editor YAML page, template or preset based on supplied content and a schema/kit.
avoidWhen: The user wants an ordinary HTML page or screenshot without native editor compatibility.

recipes.label: Produce or edit a visual asset set
recipes.summary: Create source-aware images, SVGs or banner variants with explicit composition constraints, distinct concepts where requested and complete output reconciliation.
useWhen: The task produces or edits images, product compositions, SVG conversions or a constrained set of banner concepts.
avoidWhen: The actual problem is application lifecycle or UI state rather than the visual assets themselves.

recipes.label: Reconstruct and verify motion
recipes.summary: Preserve or repair supplied animation and interactive behavior using an explicit sequence and observed full-cycle verification.
useWhen: Animation, tabs, maps, terminals, timing, transitions or interactive controls are part of the requested target.
avoidWhen: Only a static still image is requested and no motion behavior is involved.

recipes.label: Extend an existing media workspace
recipes.summary: Integrate media conversion or navigation into the current library, reusing folder identity, tree controls, drop behavior and persisted state.
useWhen: An existing media, HTML or icon library gains import, conversion, sorting, favorites, canvas or folder functionality.
avoidWhen: The task is a standalone image edit with no persistent application integration.

recipes.label: Deliver a source-grounded content site
recipes.summary: Reconcile requested pages and source content, reuse the approved presentation and verify routes, metadata, links and delivered artifacts.
useWhen: A help centre, product/page collection, Markdown site or content migration must preserve source facts and complete target coverage.
avoidWhen: The request is strategy or information architecture advice only; retain the corresponding read-only scope.

recipes.label: Verify and deliver an artifact
recipes.summary: Reconcile final source and package identity, repair in-scope delivery defects and verify the authorized destination with readback.
useWhen: A requested file, archive, export or release is missing, stale, incomplete, unstyled or not available at its authorized destination.
avoidWhen: No artifact or delivery outcome is requested; do not invent publication or storage work.

recipes.label: Improve a plugin from actual usage
recipes.summary: Analyze available usage evidence, map current coverage, implement justified instruction or routing changes and verify the same plugin release.
useWhen: The user asks to improve a plugin, skill catalogue or agent workflow using usage histories, concrete failures or exported requests.
avoidWhen: The user invokes an existing plugin to perform unrelated work, or asks only for a usage analysis without implementation.
